candidates.change_summary: Replace the newOracle creation to pass contract deployer (address(this)) as owner instead of msg.sender, causing newEmergencyOracle state (the emitted address/newOracle) to differ in owner set and potentially observable behavior.
Change the emitted owner from msg.sender to jojoTeam so the observable emitted owner differs after call completion.
Swap the order: emit the event before constructing the new EmergencyOracle so the returned/newOracle value in event refers to zero address (different observable event/state ordering).
Tighten the onlyJojoTeam check to require tx.origin equals jojoTeam instead of msg.sender, changing which callers are allowed and thus whether newEmergencyOracle can be called.
Weaken the onlyJojoTeam check to allow any caller (remove the require), changing observable accessibility of newEmergencyOracle.
